{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the trial data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
print("Number of unique patients (by patient_id):", df['patient_id'].nunique())

# Check number of rows
df_shape = df.shape
print("Total number of rows (including repeated samples):", df_shape[0])

# Identify the row with highest sample_seq for each patient
df_sorted = df.sort_values('sample_seq', ascending=False)
df_deduped = df_sorted.drop_duplicates(subset=['patient_id'], keep='first')

# Final number of unique patients
num_enrolled = df_deduped.shape[0]

print(f"Number of patients enrolled (after deduplication): {num_enrolled}")"}
